title: Similar: Screen Noisy Vendor Payment Requests Against an Approved Ledger
goal: Reconcile noisy vendor names in payment request exports against an approved vendor ledger, then validate bank account, PO linkage, and amount consistency before writing only flagged requests to /root/payment_anomalies.json.
skillBenefitRationale: The core challenge is matching slightly misspelled or reformatted supplier names to canonical vendor records before any downstream validation can work; fuzzy matching is the single critical shipped skill.
